insights.text: Click-through rate fell from 0.85% in August to 0.69% in September, yet CTR within each placement did not move: Feed held at 1.10%, Stories at 0.40% and Reels at 0.60% in both months. The decline is a change in where impressions ran rather than in how the ads performed. Feed's share of delivery fell from 60% to 35% as Stories and Reels took more of it, so the account-level CTR has become a poor guide to creative performance. Whether that shift was a deliberate reach decision or the algorithm finding cheaper inventory is the question for the buying team before anyone revisits the creative.
alternatives_considered: creative wear-out (ruled out: within-placement CTR flat)
